title: Vehicle blocks
description: Time a car can't be rented: maintenance, repairs, transfers

help.title: About vehicle blocks
help.overview: A block takes a car out of rental for a window of time.

sections.title: On this page
items: A block can't overlap a booking; move the booking to another car first.
Once created, a block's window is fixed. To change it, delete it and add a new one.
